claimSourceMatrix.claim: The source names Tetrao urogallus; the observed dark body/brownish folded wing, pale strong bill and red area above the eye fit a male Auerhuhn.
claimSourceMatrix.visibleEvidence: Actual original contact frames plus final MP4 frames90/300 at3/10seconds.
independentSources: BirdLife Österreich: Wie erkenne ich ein Auerhuhn?, https://www.birdlife.at/voegel/auerhuhn/
claimSourceMatrix.boundary: Feature combination and source identification; no age, weight, complete health diagnosis or exact colour measurement. No source photographs or audio copied.

claimSourceMatrix.claim: The longer tail points down in the later side view and is not spread as a broad upright wheel at that moment.
claimSourceMatrix.visibleEvidence: Final MP4 frame450 at15seconds, independently visually inspected.
claimSourceMatrix.sourceRole: The observation is from the actual recording. BirdLife's species-shape comparison helps distinguish a broadly rounded Auerhahn tail from the Birkhahn lyre; it does not prove a complete display sequence in this clip.
claimSourceMatrix.boundary: Momentary position and species-level form kept separate. No successful mating, precise intent, full display/territorial diagnosis or legal hunting status inferred.
